soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown, the thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white, the hairs on the head capsule sparse and those of the abdomen rather dense. The head capsule is rectangular, the lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly narrowed at the middle, the posterolateral corners broad and rounded. The frontal ridge is distinctly raised, the labrum spear-shaped. The mandibles are short and hook-like, the antennae with 14 segments. The anterior broad region of the postmentum is pentagonal, the waist narrow. The median notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum is very deep, the posterior margin only shallowly concave, the hairs of the middle region fine and small, about eight in number.
